description: This Java source file defines the `ModifyFeatureProperty` class, which represents a command to modify a specific property of a feature within an Eclipse Ditto thing. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON, accessing the property details, and serialization.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureProperty
classes.description: An immutable command class that modifies a property of a feature of a thing in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides methods for construction, serialization, and property access.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of ModifyFeatureProperty with the specified ThingId, feature ID, property pointer, value, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string or object into a ModifyFeatureProperty command instance.

methods.name: getPropertyPointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer to the property being modified.

methods.name: getPropertyValue
methods.description: Returns the JSON value of the property to be set.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the thing entity.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the property value wrapped in an Optional, for schema validation.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the resource affected by this command.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the command payload into a JSON object, considering schema version and predicate filtering.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a copy of the command with new Ditto headers.
